The '''Kedorzha system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] within the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] containing at least one [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Kedorzha]].
